summary: This video covers the Starweave Echo event and Temporal Corridor exchange shop, explaining how to convert spare Legendary Soul Imprints into Starweave Fragments. The creator details which heroes are safe to recycle by resetting their inspirations (such as Gillian, Karf, Talwer, and Vicana) and which heroes offer the best return. Talethia is identified as the single highest priority until reaching Inspiration 5, followed by options like Fredegonda, Paixton, and Alaura depending on team archetype needs. Players are advised to pull on active banners first and consider the 37-day shop rotation before spending currency.

meta_changes: Starweave Echo event allows exchanging up to 50 eligible duplicate Legendary Soul Imprints for Starweave Fragments.
Temporal Corridor's Lingering Echo shop offers select Legendary heroes for 300 or 800 fragments on a 37-day rotation.
tips: Always pull your summons on the Child of Chaos banner first before committing soul imprints to the exchange.
Review your roster and reset inspirations on powercrept or benched legendaries like Gillian to reclaim imprints for the event.
Stick to the 300-cost heroes in Temporal Corridor because purchasing two top-tier units yields significantly more account value than saving 800 for one.
Buy Talethia copies until she reaches Inspiration 5 before diversifying into other elemental archetypes.
